message.content: I noticed the change matched /analyse instead of /claudboard:claudboard-analyse — can you check why the hook fired on that session? Also the cost line said /claudboard:claudboard-generate but I ran /analyse.

content.text: The hook has a known bug where the regex matches any mention of those verbs in free-text. A fix is in progress — the new version will require the `<command-name>` wrapper before matching.
